golden_facts.text: Challenge-completion push notifications arrive twice on devices logged into two profiles
Single-profile devices receive exactly one notification
The duplicate reproduces 10 out of 10 times on build 4.0.0-b3
Killing the app or muting one profile does not prevent the duplicate
Earlier 3.x builds with the same dual-profile setup show a single notification

extracted_facts.text: On Meridian fitness app 4.0-beta (build 4.0.0-b3), push notifications for completed challenges arrive twice on devices where the user is logged into two profiles (personal + coach mode)
The duplicate notification behavior is a regression from 3.x, where the same dual-profile setup produced a single notification
Suggested priority for the bug is high
Double push notifications have historically caused uninstalls
Single-profile devices are not affected and receive exactly one notification
Both copies of the duplicate notification arrive within a second of each other
Both duplicate notifications deep-link to the same challenge screen
Killing the app does not stop the duplicate notifications
Muting one profile does not stop the duplicate notifications
